version.changelog: 安全加固：重写SKILL.md去除CLI命令，清理冗余文件，规范元数据声明

llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed Chinese-language utility package for agent memory, knowledge graphs, task execution, case search, and report generation, with no evidence of hidden installation, network exfiltration, or persistence hooks.

dimensions.detail: The code uses local Python data structures and a ThreadPoolExecutor for caller-supplied functions. It does not perform shell execution, filesystem writes, network calls, credential reads, or broad local indexing in the inspected implementation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package has a SKILL.md manifest entry, no install script, no declared permissions, no dependency installation, and no remote payload retrieval. Environment variables are optional and marked sensitive.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions and user-facing strings are almost entirely Chinese, which is visible in the manifest and SKILL.md. I found no prompt hijacking, role override, hidden evaluator instructions, or agent safety bypass text.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The documentation advertises cross-session/permanent memory and metadata declares storage at ~/.qiaomai/, but the inspected memory implementation is process-local unless callers explicitly import or export data. Clear and export methods are present; stronger user-facing retention guidance would be helpful.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The shipped modules match the stated purpose: in-memory layered memory, knowledge graph structures, case search, report formatting, simple intent parsing, and callable task execution. Optional API keys are declared in metadata and documentation, but the inspected code does not actually read or call those services.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable with a Chinese-language agent utility package and intentionally want memory-style data structures. Treat memory exports as sensitive because they can contain user-provided content; review what is stored before sharing or syncing it elsewhere.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The memory/export concern is purpose-aligned for a memory-management skill and is partly disclosed by the memory-layer table. The implementation returns exported memory to the caller but does not send it over the network or automatically persist it.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-only documentation and output are real and visible, but they are not hidden behavior or a security bypass. Users who do not read Chinese may need extra review before installing.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The reported behavior mismatches, such as placeholder PDF output and setup scenario handling, are quality/documentation issues rather than evidence of malicious or high-impact security behavior.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The static A.I.G scan reported no T01-T09 results, which is consistent with the inspected absence of prompt hijacking, remote execution, privilege escalation, or persistence mechanisms.
